evidence.quote: In response to MongoDB’s planned discontinuation of HTTPS endpoints by September 2025, we have engineered a robust serverless solution leveraging AWS Lambda and Amazon API Gateway to integrate with MongoDB instances.

RESTHeart is a lightweight platform that transforms your MongoDB data into a secure and extensible REST-based service.
